purpose: E2: remove one principle-related function group (def:principle_related_functions, 7 groups) or one additional element from both individuals' mechanisms in the v2 toy, and compare the collapse-reaching times with the full mechanism on held-out seeds.

ablation_implementation.-integ: M1 の時間統合を外す（見えないものの信念を直ちに失効させる）
ablation_implementation.-feas: M2 の Π_eval を定数にし、自己状態の閾値に基づく欠乏・警告の要請を出さない
ablation_implementation.-resp: 先読みを外し（深さ 1）、候補を目的から生成せず U 全体に固定する
ablation_implementation.-envuse: 必要環境要因（energy・heat）に関わる目的の形成と候補の追加を外す
ablation_implementation.-select: 適合度を一定にし、選択射影の既定順だけで選ぶ
ablation_implementation.-update: Update を恒等写像にする（学習・忘却・記録の更新なし）
ablation_implementation.-phys: PSL-4 の保護応答と repair を外す
ablation_implementation.-auto: ルーティン応答（比較を経ない応答）を外す
ablation_implementation.-relation: relation の要請（合図・贈与）を外す
ablation_implementation.-rescuers: relation を外し、ドローンと組織も除く

ablation_mapping_note: The mapping from the paper's function groups to code-level removals is a toy convention; another implementation of the same removal could give different results.
tuning_history: The v2 mechanism was tuned on seed 1 (fixed severe-cold periods).  The ablation switches were written before any run.  One smoke test of all 11 conditions on tuning seed 1 (eat_gain 5, regen 3, snap_jitter 10) was run before registration and showed T_col_sum: full 334, -integ 172, -feas 57, -resp 236, -envuse 57, -select 131, -update 252, -phys 334, -auto 539, -relation 468, -rescuers 468.  Seeds 11-60 were not run before registration.
metric_note: T_col_sum = T_col(i) + T_col(j), a structure lost at no time within 300 steps counted as 301.
